summary: Tonga’s restoration pledge builds on its reported completion of a one-million-tree campaign in 2023 and recommits to planting another 1 million trees by 2030, with diverse species, food-security benefits and maintained forest cover. Under the mixed forestry/agroforestry commitment, the 30% land target combines both land uses. Agriculture also includes capacity-building and adoption support on at least 2,000 hectares. Conservation combines a 2035 goal to construct or rehabilitate 4.3 km of integrated coastal protection in Hahake with expanding MPAs and SMAs to 30% of Tonga’s EEZ; related goals include doubling the 2015 MPA count by 2030 and aiming for 100 SMAs under the 2025–2030 strategy. In geographic terms, 30% of Tonga’s 708 km² land area equals about 212.4 km², roughly 68.5% of the currently mapped 310 km² agricultural area, though the pledge covers agroforestry or forestry rather than a separate land class.
